notebookPages.protocolName: IPTG-Induced Recombinant Protein Expression in BL21(DE3)

protocolSnapshot.name: BL21(DE3) Chemical Transformation with pET28a
protocolSnapshot.purpose: Introduce a plasmid into BL21(DE3) competent E. coli cells for protein expression.

steps.text: Thaw 1 tube of BL21(DE3) competent cells on ice.
Add 200ng of {{ph:1774125436234-cac9aa958fe75}} DNA to the cells and gently flick to mix.
Incubate the mixture on ice for 30 min.
Heat shock the cells at 45 C for 45 s, then immediately place them back on ice for 1 min.
Add 1 mL of SOC medium and recover the cells at 37 C with shaking for 1 h.
Plate 100 uL of the recovery culture onto an LB agar plate containing Kanamycin.
Incubate the plate at 37 C for overnight until colonies appear.

protocolSnapshot.name: Small-Scale Overnight Starter Culture
protocolSnapshot.purpose: Prepare a starter culture from a single bacterial colony for downstream expression or plasmid preparation.

steps.text: Add {{ph:1774024647315-9f03b8d734f3c}} of LB medium containing {{ph:1774024647315-9ce336955a66c}} antibiotic to a sterile culture tube.
Pick a single colony from a fresh plate and inoculate the medium.
Incubate the culture at 37 C with shaking at {{ph:1774024647315-09eb7ed8adca9}} for {{ph:1774024647315-82400c92a18e08}}.
Inspect the culture for turbidity and record the culture ID, date, and plasmid name in the notebook.

notebookPages.protocolName: IPTG-Induced Recombinant Protein Expression in BL21(DE3)

protocolSnapshot.name: IPTG-Induced Recombinant Protein Expression in BL21(DE3)
protocolSnapshot.purpose: Express a recombinant protein in BL21(DE3) cells using IPTG induction.

steps.text: Inoculate {{ph:1774024680081-ff5ea222c2b28}} of expression medium containing {{ph:1774024680081-2608acdba053b}} with {{ph:1774024680081-b41278cd1047f8}} of overnight starter culture.
Grow the culture at 37 C with shaking until OD600 reaches {{ph:1774024680081-fab6fafbcf158}}.
Add IPTG to a final concentration of {{ph:1774024680081-587c106fae95a}} to induce protein expression.
Shift the culture to {{ph:1774024680081-2ce357c07b8e68}} and continue shaking for {{ph:1774024680081-1e13340d6a10c}}.
Harvest cells by centrifugation at {{ph:1774024680081-d82f101f8190e8}} for {{ph:1774024680081-ad983f4a2f5b68}} at {{ph:1774024680081-4962dce7ed7eb8}}.
Record pellet appearance, culture volume, induction time, and temperature in the notebook.

protocolSnapshot.name: Ni-NTA Purification of His-Tagged Protein
protocolSnapshot.purpose: Purify a His-tagged recombinant protein using nickel affinity resin.

steps.text: Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 mL of lysis buffer
Lyse the cells using sonication and clarify the lysate by centrifugation at 10,000 rpm for 30 mins.
Equilibrate 5 mL of Ni-NTA resin with 20 mL of lysis buffer.
Load the clarified lysate onto the resin.
Wash the resin with 40 mL of wash buffer containing 20 mM imidazole.
Elute the bound protein using 6 mL of elution buffer containing 300 mM imidazole.
Collect fractions and analyze them by SDS-PAGE.

protocolSnapshot.name: TEV Protease Cleavage of Fusion Protein
protocolSnapshot.purpose: Remove an affinity or solubility tag from a fusion protein using TEV protease.

steps.text: Exchange the fusion protein into cleavage buffer using {{ph:1774024712936-7dba43a18d95f8}}.
Add TEV protease at an enzyme-to-substrate ratio of {{ph:1774024712936-8060b8a60ca3b}}.
Incubate the reaction at {{ph:1774024712936-51cd47e4df67a}} for {{ph:1774024712936-bf51d65dc5d7e}}.
Remove an aliquot before and after cleavage for SDS-PAGE analysis.
Separate the cleaved tag, uncleaved protein, and TEV protease using {{ph:1774024712936-e83fc6a9af4a2}}.

protocolSnapshot.purpose: Biotinylate an Avi-tagged protein for downstream binding assays or immobilization.

steps.text: Prepare the biotinylation reaction by combining {{ph:1774024745003-093192d094133}} of Avi-tagged protein, {{ph:1774024745003-fbbbfbaa73e5b}} of BirA, {{ph:1774024745003-d6f73ec6557a1}} of biotin, ATP, and buffer.
Remove excess free biotin using {{ph:1774024745003-d1b54c3887f0f8}}.
Assess biotinylation efficiency using {{ph:1774024745003-0dd0ef09f4b6c}}, such as streptavidin shift or binding assay.

protocolSnapshot.name: Protein Builder Cloning Assembly
protocolSnapshot.purpose: Design cloning primers and PCR setup for a Protein Builder assembled construct.

steps.text: Amplify insert: PCR-amplify the insert with restriction-site tails from the primer plan.
Digest DNA: Digest backbone and insert with the selected enzyme pair, then purify both products.
Ligate construct: Ligate digested insert into the prepared backbone.
Transform and screen: Transform competent cells and screen colonies by colony PCR and sequencing.

- Protein Builder Insert_R; role: Restriction Reverse; sequence: GCGCACGCGTATGATGGTGATGGTGGTGTGACTGAAA; length: 37 nt; Tm: 58.2 C; GC: 54.1%; notes: Adds MluI to the 5' end.

Assembly procedure
1. Amplify insert: PCR-amplify the insert with restriction-site tails from the primer plan.
2. Digest DNA: Digest backbone and insert with the selected enzyme pair, then purify both products.
3. Ligate construct: Ligate digested insert into the prepared backbone.
4. Transform and screen: Transform competent cells and screen colonies by colony PCR and sequencing.

Validation plan
- colony-pcr, left/right cloning junctions: Confirm insert presence and orientation.
- sanger-sequencing, entire insert region: Verify insert integrity after ligation.
